# migronaut

> Production-grade MongoDB migration toolkit for Node.js and TypeScript, with zero runtime
> dependencies. Run a single migration file, roll back any batch or the last N, preview with dry-run,
> wrap migrations in transactions, verify file checksums, and run safely behind a native MongoDB
> concurrency lock — via the `migronaut` CLI or a fully-typed programmatic API. An alternative to
> migrate-mongo, with one-command import of an existing migrate-mongo changelog. Also the maintained
> successor to `mongo-migrate-kit` (CLI `mmk`), which it was forked from.

Key facts:
- Package (npm): `@alexify/migronaut` — install with `npm install @alexify/migronaut mongodb`
- CLI binary: `migronaut`
- Requires Node.js >= 22.18 and MongoDB >= 5.0; supports TypeScript, ESM, and CommonJS
- Zero runtime dependencies; `mongodb` is a required peer, `mongoose` an optional one
- Optional queue adapter at `@alexify/migronaut/bullmq`: migrations as BullMQ jobs (one migration
  per job). BullMQ is injected by the caller (`bullmq: { Queue, Worker }`) — never a dependency
- Optional OpenTelemetry: `telemetry: { tracer, meter }` from the caller's own
  `@opentelemetry/api` — injected, never a dependency or a peer
- Declared collections (experimental): indexes, Atlas Search / Vector Search indexes and
  validators declared as an end state in `collections` / `collectionsDir`, applied statelessly by
  `migronaut converge` (or `convergeAfterUp` after every bulk `up`) — no migration file per change;
  a search index is updated in place, never rebuilt
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/migronaut

## Guide

- [Why migronaut?](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/why): Reasons to choose it and how it compares to migrate-mongo
- [vs. mongo-migrate-kit](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/vs-mongo-migrate-kit): What changed since the mmk fork, and why
- [Core Concepts](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/concepts): Migrations, batches, the changelog, ordering, locking, and checksums
- [Getting Started](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/getting-started): Install, configure, create, and run your first migration
- [Tutorial](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/tutorial): End-to-end worked example from init to rollback
- [Configuration](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/configuration): Config file, env vars, precedence, and all options
- [Writing Migrations](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/writing-migrations): The up/down contract in TypeScript, ESM, and CommonJS
- [Transactions](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/transactions): Opt-in MongoDB transactions per file or globally
- [Lifecycle Hooks](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/hooks): beforeAll, afterAll, beforeEach, afterEach, onError
- [Declared Collections](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/collections): Declare indexes, Atlas Search / Vector Search indexes and validators as an end state; converge compares with the live database and applies the difference
- [Programmatic API](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/api): The MigratorKit class, methods, and result types
- [Migrations as a Queue (BullMQ)](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/bullmq): Run migrations as BullMQ jobs — a migration service with ordering, batches, scheduling, and enqueue-and-wait
- [OpenTelemetry](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/opentelemetry): Traces and metrics through an injected tracer and meter — a span per run and per migration, with the MongoDB driver's spans nested under it
- [CI/CD & Deployment](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/ci-cd): GitHub Actions, Docker, deploy gates, and JSON output
- [Troubleshooting](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/troubleshooting): Common errors and how to fix them
- [Migrating from migrate-mongo](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/migrate-mongo): Adopt an existing migrate-mongo changelog
- [FAQ](https://migronaut.vercel.app/guide/faq): Common questions about running MongoDB migrations

## Commands

- [migronaut up](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/up): Run all pending migrations, or a single file
- [migronaut down](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/down): Roll back the last batch, a batch, the last N, or a file
- [migronaut redo](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/redo): Roll back then re-apply a migration
- [migronaut converge](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/converge): Bring declared indexes and validators to their declared state; --check gates CI
- [migronaut status & list](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/status): Inspect migration state; --check gates CI
- [migronaut create & init](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/create): Scaffold migrations and generate a config
- [migronaut dry-run](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/dry-run): Preview up/down without touching the database
- [migronaut audit](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/audit): Read-only health check of config, connectivity, and locks
- [migronaut import](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/import): Adopt a migrate-mongo changelog (forward-only)
- [migronaut lock](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/lock): Inspect the current migration lock holder
- [migronaut unlock](https://migronaut.vercel.app/commands/unlock): Force-release a stuck concurrency lock

## Reference

- [CLI Cheatsheet](https://migronaut.vercel.app/reference/cli): Every command and flag on one page
- [Error Codes](https://migronaut.vercel.app/reference/error-codes): All error codes, classes, causes, and fixes
